### God Can Restore What’s Been Lost and Broken
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-13-2018.html
Passage: Job 42:10
Points:
- Devastating life circumstances can cause overwhelming anxiety when we try to solve them on our own.
- God does not merely want us to voice our worries, but to surrender them fully to Him in trust.
- Even in his intense grief and confusion, Job continued to worship God and trust His sovereignty.
- God ultimately honored Job's perseverance by restoring his relationships and doubling his former fortunes.
- True spiritual restoration begins when believers release control and expectantly trust God's timing and goodness.

### CHOOSE GOD’S WILL
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-nov-21-2008-11595969.html
Passage: Job 42:10-17
Points:
- A primary goal of the Christian life is to grow up spiritually as one grows older.
- Job reached genuine spiritual maturity through suffering, finishing his days full of life and devotion.
- When hardship arrives, believers can view it either as an outrage or as an opportunity for obedience.
- True endurance is not passive resignation, but active persistence in seeking holiness.
- Choosing God's will in the midst of trials transforms difficult circumstances into lasting maturity.
